info.name: AWS Data Exchange API
info.description:
The AWS Data Exchange API enables programmatic access to find, subscribe to, and use third-party data products. It supports managing data sets, revisions, assets, jobs, and subscriptions for cloud-based data exchange workflows.

Contact Support:
 Name: AWS Support
